name: 38794-imageprefill-gemma34b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), node to itself.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine on one card, driven by guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
architecture: Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration -- 34-layer text decoder plus a SigLIP vision tower at 896x896, 256 image tokens per image, bf16, ~8.6 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 20%, bounded at 1280 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` + `synthetic_image`, single turn: exactly one 896x896 JPEG (quality 85, gradient, reseeded per request) and exactly 64 text prompt tokens in, exactly 32 output tokens out, zero variance on all three; `temperature: 0`.
purpose: A multimodal image-and-text assistant captioning one high-resolution photo per request for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it
tensor-parallel-size: 1
attention-backend: TRITON_ATTN
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-seqs: 64
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
# Must match scenario.json `images_per_request`; keep the mapping on ONE line -- the reader
# skips indented lines, so a block mapping drops the key and the engine starts without it.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-prefix-caching: true
